prompt:
Consider the following company information, reported as of 2025-11-06. Act as a credit rating analyst.
| Current ratio           | 1.32 |
| Retained earnings       | 68,459M |
| Current liabilities     | 12,009M |
| Current assets          | 15,884M |
| Shareholders' equity    | 64,923M |
| Total liabilities       | 57,549M |
| Total assets            | 122,472M |
| EBIT / operating income | 2,702M |
| Revenue                 | 14,969M |
Based only on the above and knowledge predating 2025-11-06, assign the issuer a letter credit rating on the 21-grade scale below (finest granularity you can justify). Choose exactly one label from: AAA, AA+, AA, AA-, A+, A, A-, BBB+, BBB, BBB-, BB+, BB, BB-, B+, B, B-, CCC+, CCC, CCC-, CC, C.
Reason briefly in 1-3 sentences. Then, on a separate final line, output exactly:

raw_response:
The company exhibits a strong equity base (Shareholders' equity of 64,923M against Total assets of 122,472M), indicating a solid capital structure and ability to withstand financial shocks. While profitability (EBIT of 2,702M on Revenue of 14,969M) and current liquidity (Current ratio of 1.32) are acceptable, the overall financial health, particularly the substantial retained earnings, suggests a capacity to meet financial commitments.

DECISION: A-
